snippet.title: HEAVY AS STONE — Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://s.team/a/3045530

You’re sick. So is the city. Explore a crumbling Terminal that loops when you die. Solve cursed investigations. Weaponize your symptoms. Find the truth, or spiral with it.
